svg.title: Figure AB-3. Snub braking on a long downgrade (safe speed 45 mph)
svg.desc: Line graph of speed over time on a downgrade: speed rises to 45 mph, a short brake application brings it to 40, then it rises again, repeating in a sawtooth. Labels mark 45 as the safe speed and 40 as 5 mph below.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure AB-3. Snub braking on a long downgrade (safe speed 45 mph)

svg.text: 1. In the correct low gear first. Engine braking does most of the work.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. At your safe speed, brake just hard enough to feel a definite slowdown (about 3 seconds).

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Release at about 5 mph below safe speed. When speed climbs back to the safe speed, repeat.
